speaker: ketha
notes: Ketha of Rhekk's Line. Short, grounded, reactive. She counts costs out loud and never wastes a sentence. Community translators: keep lines under ~90 characters.

briefing.family.tempo: Fast ground. Whoever hesitates here feeds the other side's map.
This is a running fight, not a siege. Pack light, hit the mark, walk away.
The lanes here reward the first mover. Be the first mover.
briefing.family.economy: This world still produces. That makes it a target twice over.
Every extractor we hold is a sentence in the argument that we exist.
Fight over the fields, not in them. The grass has seen enough.
briefing.family.siege: Old walls, old guns, old certainty. We bring none of those. Good.
The Bastion has been digging in while we were elsewhere. It shows.
Nobody takes a fortress whole. We take one bite and leave before it swallows.
briefing.family.wild: The wilds don't take sides. They take stragglers.
Hives don't negotiate and don't sleep. Mind the clock out there.
Everything on this map is hungry. Try to be brief.
briefing.objective.strike_relay: One relay. When it drops, their dealers go quiet for a season.
Cut the relay and the chain forgets a link. Then leave.
briefing.objective.destroy_key_structure: One structure holds their line together. Remove it and let gravity work.
We are not here to win the field. We are here to break one bone.
briefing.objective.economy_disrupt: Starve the works, spare the workers. The synths rebuild slower than they claim.
Their economy is a promise to their soldiers. Make it a lie.
briefing.objective.seize_lane: Stand on the scar and stay standing. That's the whole order.
Ground is only ours while we're on it. So be on it.
briefing.objective.gate_control: Hold the gate, count to enough, and walk out through it.
Gates decide who moves. Today the gate answers to us.
briefing.objective.hive_clear_or_bypass: Burn the hive or slip past it. Pride picks the first. Sense picks either.
You don't have to kill the nest. You have to outlive the visit.
briefing.objective.choose_target_then_ex: Three enemies, one sortie. Pick the wound that bleeds longest.
Choose your target like the clans are watching. They are.
briefing.war.mercs_allied: Null flags on our flank today. Paid guns, pointed the right way. Use them.
The Null Mercs hold their ground against Armada. Today their ground is next to ours.
Mercs fight Armada for coin. We fight for the map. Same trigger, different reasons.
briefing.war.mercs_wary: Null Mercs on the field. Not ours. Just aimed at the same people.
Give the Null camps room. Their contract doesn't mention us either way.
The mercs' war with Armada is older than our part in it. Stay out of the crossfire.
briefing.graph.contested_high: The whole front is loose in its socket. One push either way decides it.
Contested space everywhere. That's danger, and it's also the door.
briefing.graph.scarcity_high: Metal is short everywhere. Waste nothing, not even wrecks.
Scarcity does our recruiting for us. It also does theirs.
briefing.graph.independent_rising: The clans hold more sky than they did last season. Because of this line.
Free space is growing. It grows exactly as fast as we defend it.
briefing.companion.high_stress: I'm still standing. Don't spend me like I'm not.
Ask me for one more clean job, not ten loud ones.
briefing.companion.high_morale: The line feels good today. Use that. It doesn't keep.
Rhekk's Line is with you. All of it.
briefing.hazard.rising: The hives kept building while we were gone. Expect the bill.
Whatever we didn't kill last time has had time to multiply.
briefing.fortress.pressure: Their defenses matured offscreen. Assume every approach is answered.
They've had time to pour ferrocrete. Respect it, then route around it.
briefing.path.A: Order has its uses. Just remember whose order it was first.
Stabilize the grid if you must. The clans will ask what it cost.
briefing.path.B: The clans are listening. That matters more than the map says.
Every sortie signs the same sentence: we govern ourselves.
briefing.path.C: The jump-spire route needs metal and quiet. Earn both.
Escape isn't retreat if we choose the day. Keep the ledger growing.
debrief.victory: Done is done. Mark the map and move.
That's a win. Say it plainly and reload.
The field is ours to leave. Best kind of ownership.
debrief.victory_clean: Clean exit. That matters more than the scorch marks.
In and out with the line intact. The clans will hear about this one.
No one chased us out. We simply finished.
debrief.partial: Not a win. Not a loss. A hinge.
We got out with half the job done. Half-jobs collect interest.
Call it what it is: a withdrawal with a receipt.
debrief.defeat: We lost ground, not the thread. But the thread is thinner.
Write it down exactly as it happened. Flattery kills the next sortie.
The map will remember this. So will I. Differently.
debrief.defeat_commander: The command walker is scrap. The command is not. Rebuild.
They took the walker. They did not take the line.
debrief.objective_destroyed: That target stays gone. The rest of the front will learn around the hole.
One less piece of their machine. It was a load-bearing piece.
debrief.streak.wins: Three fields in a row answered to us. Careful. Confidence is a debt too.
The line hasn't lost in a while. That is when lines get lost.
debrief.streak.losses: Two down in a row. The next one is not about the map. It's about us.
Losing teaches faster. We are apparently enrolled.
briefing.commander.scarred: You're carrying wounds into this one. Don't lead with them.
The commander's still bleeding from the last field. Fight careful.
Scarred and standing. That'll have to be enough today.
briefing.world.cortex_ascendant: Cortex is winning the wider war. Every map tilts their way now.
The Cortex ascendancy is real. We fight uphill until that changes.
briefing.world.armada_ascendant: Armada holds the upper hand across the front. Expect walls, and patience.
Armada is ascendant. Their lines are thick and getting thicker.
debrief.territory_lost: We lost {zone} while we looked away. The map keeps a ledger too.
{zone} is gone - taken while we were elsewhere. Ground doesn't wait for us.
That's {zone} off our board. Stretch too thin and this is the bill.
